verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships Graph view as a core plugin that visualizes the relationships between notes in a vault (obsidian-docs-3), built on internal links that form a network of knowledge (obsidian-docs-18). The same docs page says you can filter the graph with a search term (obsidian-docs-42). One community user called the graph gimmicky for their own workflow (obsidian-comm-8), which is opinion rather than evidence it fails. Missing for 10: documentation of interactive behaviour (clicking or navigating nodes, local graph), richer filter options (tags, groups, depth), and independent hands-on corroboration of filtering.
